title: How is Elvis Presley connected to Barack Obama?
description:
Four real photos connect Elvis Presley to Barack Obama.

Elvis Presley → Richard Nixon → Gerald Ford → Bill Clinton → Barack Obama

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Elvis Presley → Richard Nixon: In December 1970, Elvis showed up at the White House and asked Richard Nixon to make him a federal drug agent.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Elvis-nixon.jpg
2. Richard Nixon → Gerald Ford: In 1973, Nixon picked Gerald Ford as his vice president. Less than a year later, Ford had Nixon's job.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mr._and_Mrs._Ford_and_Nixon_13_Oct_1973.jpg
3. Gerald Ford → Bill Clinton: In 1997, Ford shared a stage with President Bill Clinton at the opening of a presidential library in Texas.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Clinton_with_former_presidents_George_H._W._Bush,_Gerald_Ford,_and_Jimmy_Carter_wave_from_the_stage_at_the_dedication_of_the_George_H._W._Bush_Presidential_Library_at_Texa_-_DPLA_-_34dd2e1f15a119c9c93c3b2c42c179f0.jpg
4. Bill Clinton → Barack Obama: And in 2013, Barack Obama hung the Presidential Medal of Freedom around Clinton's neck.
   Photo by Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bill_clinton_medal_of_freedom.jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
